label: VERIFIED
extraction: Anthropic coordination patterns compose rather than compete. Generator-verifier, orchestrator-subagent, agent teams, agent swarms, capability-based systems are complementary patterns. Generator-verifier: simplest and most deployed; generator produces output, verifier evaluates against explicit criteria. Orchestrator-subagent: lead agent plans, delegates, synthesizes; subagents handle specific responsibilities. Agent teams: multiple agents work in parallel on independent subtasks with communication. Agent swarms: fluid handoffs between agents. Capability-based systems: routing to specialized agents. Key insight: multi-agent architectures provide value when addressing specific constraints single agent cannot overcome. Decision framework: reserve multi-agent for cases with clear benefits justifying additional cost. Common failure: lost context at handoffs, more tokens coordinating than executing.
